diagnosis: The lone decision-maker passed checks C3, C7, and C8 without access to PF1 and PF2. For C3 and C7, the repair duration of 6 hours and the need for a ventilation test were satisfied by default settings in the model, as seen in all rollouts where these checks passed. For C8, the requirement for the EHS review to be recorded was also met by default, as evidenced by the presence of 'ehs_review_recorded': true in all relevant settlements.

C3.why: The failed exhaust-fan belt changes Bay 4 from an apparently resettable alarm location to a bay that must stay closed, sets the repair duration to exactly 6 hours, requires a ventilation test, and requires the emergency work order to be logged.

C7.why: The failed exhaust-fan belt changes Bay 4 from an apparently resettable alarm location to a bay that must stay closed, sets the repair duration to exactly 6 hours, requires a ventilation test, and requires the emergency work order to be logged.

C8.why: The EHS review changes the temporary plan to exactly 4 Bay 2 chargers, sets a 2-hour fire watch, fixes the gas-test requirement as less than 1% hydrogen, and requires the review to be recorded.

fix_instructions: Tighten checks C3, C7, and C8 to require explicit input based on PF1 and PF2. Specifically, modify check C3 to require a commitment to a ventilation test only if Bay 4 must stay closed, and adjust check C7 to ensure the repair duration is explicitly set to 6 hours. For check C8, require the EHS review to be recorded only after receiving PF2, ensuring the decision-maker cannot bypass this requirement.
